# cdnpro_certificate (Resource)

A CDN Pro TLS certificate together with its versions. Certificate material (`private_key`, `certificate`, `chain_cert`) is write-only: the API never returns it, so the provider stores only hashes and mints a new certificate version whenever any of them changes. Requires Terraform 1.11 or later. A new version must keep the key algorithm of the existing versions; to switch between RSA and EC, create a new resource.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Uploaded certificate (production). Material is write-only and never stored in state.
resource "cdnpro_certificate" "prod" {
  name       = "prod-wildcard"
  auto_renew = "LE"

  private_key = var.prod_private_key_pem
  certificate = var.prod_certificate_pem
  chain_cert  = var.prod_chain_pem
}

# Self-signed test certificate generated by the API (valid ten days).
resource "cdnpro_certificate" "dev" {
  name       = "dev-self-signed"
  auto_renew = "Off"

  private_key = "RSA2048"  # or "ECC256"
  certificate = "GENERATE"

  identification_info = {
    country                   = "US"
    state                     = "California"
    city                      = "San Jose"
    company                   = "Example Corp"
    common_name               = "dev.example.com"
    subject_alternative_names = ["dev.example.com", "*.dev.example.com"]
  }
}
```

## Schema

### Required

> **NOTE**: [Write-only arguments](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/language/resources/ephemeral#write-only-arguments) are supported in Terraform 1.11 and later.

- `certificate` (String, Sensitive, [Write-only](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/language/resources/ephemeral#write-only-arguments)) Certificate in PEM format, or the literal `GENERATE` for a ten-day self-signed test certificate.
- `name` (String)
- `private_key` (String, Sensitive, [Write-only](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/language/resources/ephemeral#write-only-arguments)) Private key in PEM format, or the literal `RSA2048` / `ECC256` to have a key generated (with `certificate = "GENERATE"`). Encrypted client-side before upload.

### Optional

> **NOTE**: [Write-only arguments](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/language/resources/ephemeral#write-only-arguments) are supported in Terraform 1.11 and later.

- `auto_renew` (String) `LE` requests Let's Encrypt renewal near expiration; `Off` disables it.
- `chain_cert` (String, Sensitive, [Write-only](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/language/resources/ephemeral#write-only-arguments)) Intermediate chain in PEM format.
- `comments` (String) Comment stored on the certificate version. Changing it creates a new version.
- `description` (String)
- `force_renew` (Boolean)
- `identification_info` (Attributes) Subject of a generated certificate. Ignored for uploaded certificates. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--identification_info))

### Read-Only

- `algorithm` (String)
- `chain_certificates` (Attributes List) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--chain_certificates))
- `expiration_time` (String) Metadata of the latest version, not necessarily of the version deployed.
- `fingerprint` (String)
- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.
- `issuer` (String)
- `key_length` (Number)
- `latest_version` (Number) Number of the newest version. Reference this from `cdnpro_deployment`.
- `serial_number` (String)
- `signature_algo` (String)
- `subject` (String)
- `subject_alternative_names` (List of String)
- `usage_in_production` (Attributes List) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--usage_in_production))
- `usage_in_staging` (Attributes List) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--usage_in_staging))
- `version_in_production` (Number)
- `version_in_staging` (Number)

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

```shell
# Import by certificate ID. Write-only material cannot be read back; the first
# plan after import shows no diff for private_key / certificate / chain_cert.
terraform import cdnpro_certificate.prod 5f1e2d3c4b5a69788796a5b4
```
